mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pi_session_entry (biz_id, session_id, seq, entry_type, parent_id, run_id, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{entryType}, #{parentId}, #{runId}, #{payload}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_id, session_id, seq, entry_type, parent_id, run_id, payload, created_at FROM pi_session_entry WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq ASC
